source: This is the reason it is misleading to compare a ZXMATH0000XZ ZXNAME0000XZ ZXNAME0001XZ against a ZXMATH0001XZ ZXNAME0002XZ ZXNAME0003XZ and attribute every difference to the activation: the latter has an extra large projection matrix.
zh: 这就是将 ZXMATH0000XZ ZXNAME0000XZ ZXNAME0001XZ 与 ZXMATH0001XZ ZXNAME0002XZ ZXNAME0003XZ 进行比较并将每个差异归因于激活会产生误导的原因：后者具有超大的投影矩阵。
